script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Comedy
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

JANE, early 40s, a successful career woman, sits alone at a table, sipping her coffee and staring at her laptop. She looks tired and stressed. The café is filled with the hustle and bustle of urban life.

Waitress brings over a refill.

WAITRESS (cheerfully)
Another one? You really need to take it easy, Jane.

JANE (forcing a smile)
I'll try, thank you.

INT. JANE'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Jane enters her apartment, slamming the door behind her. She collapses on the couch, exhausted. Her cat, Mr. Whiskers, curls up beside her.

Suddenly, her phone rings. It's her old college friend, MARK. They reconnect after years of losing touch.

MARK (voiceover)
Hey, long time no talk! How have you been?

JANE
Mark! I'm so glad to hear from you. I've been... busy.

MARK
Busy? I bet. You're always the one pushing herself too hard. Come on, let's take a break. I've got a cabin upstate. We'll relax, catch up, and maybe even reconnect with some old friends.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jane hesitates, looking at her laptop and then at the phone.

JANE
I don't know, Mark. I have a lot going on here.

INT. MARK'S APARTMENT - NIGHT

Mark listens patiently as Jane voices her concerns over the phone.

MARK
Jane, when was the last time you took a real break? You're always on the go, and I think you could use some time to unwind. Besides, who knows? You might meet someone special.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

Jane thinks for a moment, then smiles.

JANE
Alright, I'll do it. I'll meet you at the cabin this weekend.

INT. CABIN IN THE WOODS - DAY

Jane arrives at the cabin, greeted by Mark and several other old college friends. They spend the day catching up, sharing stories, and reminiscing about old times.

INT. NIGHT

Everyone gathers around a campfire. Mark introduces them to a new friend, PETER, who also attended their college.

PETER
(smiling)
It's so good to see everyone again! I remember Jane as a fierce and determined student.

JANE (chuckles)
Well, not much has changed, I guess.

PETER
Actually, I think it's time for a change. You've worked hard for a long time, Jane. Don't you deserve a little happiness?

JANE (pauses)
I suppose so.

INT. CABIN KITCHEN - NIGHT

Everyone gathers around the kitchen table, drinking and sharing stories. Mark passes around old photos, and they all laugh at their youthful antics.

MARK
Remember this one, Jane?

JANE (laughs)
Oh, yes! The time we all stayed up all night to finish that group project.

INT. CAMPGROUND - DAY

The group takes a hike through the woods. They encounter a group of teenagers who've gotten lost. Jane leads the effort to help them find their way back to the campsite.

INT. CAMPGROUND - NIGHT

Everyone gathers around a campfire. Jane shares stories of her career successes, and the group listens with admiration.

PETER
Jane, you're quite an inspiration.

JANE (blushing)
Thank you, Peter. But it's all thanks to your encouragement and support back then.

INT. JANE'S TENT - NIGHT

Jane sits in her tent, thinking. She hears laughter and music from the campfire outside. A sense of peace settles over her.

JANE (whispering)
Thank you, Mark. This has been exactly what I needed.

EXT. MORNING

The group prepares to leave the cabin. Jane hugs her friends goodbye, feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.

As she drives home, she receives a call from her boss. He offers her a new, high-profile project, promising her the recognition and success she's worked so hard for.

JANE (smiling)
I'd be happy to take it on.

FADE OUT.
